name: @roadmaps/api
description: The DHCW Roadmaps API: a FastAPI service over PostgreSQL 18 (ADR-017). Its scripts run through uv.

scripts.format: uv run --locked ruff format && uv run --locked ruff check --fix
scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff format --check && uv run --locked ruff check && uv run --locked lint-imports && uv run --locked python tools/check_transactions.py
